title: antidote
tagline: Permissioned  Institutional Margin Call Protection Protocol

prizes.title: Most Innovative use of Pyth pull price Feeds

description: Antidote is the first fully permissioned, atomic-margin risk insurance protocol embedded directly into Uniswap v4 AMMs. By combining institutional-grade KYC via Coinbase x402 payments, real-time Pyth price data with pull architecture and privacy-preserving automated claims, Antidote empowers institutions to hedge margin call liquidations dynamically and compliantly. Antidote transforms systemic liquidation risk into a manageable, tokenized asset class, bridging Web2 regulatory trust with Web3 composability to redefine institutional decentralized finance risk management.
how_its_made:
Antidote enables institutional  players to hedge forced liquidation and margin call risks by:
1) Deploying Uniswap v4 Stable-Asset Pools with Margin Call Insurance Hooks implementing atomic, trade-level insurance logic directly within AMM operations
2) Integrating Coinbase x402 & CDP Facilitator for KYC/AML-gated institutional access, where institutions verify wallet compliance via 1 USDC payment flow with automatic regulatory verification
3) Utilizing Pyth Oracle Pull Architecture with real-time price feeds from Hermes service for accurate dynamic premium pricing and margin trigger detection via on-chain price updates
4) Issuing Tokenized Fractional Risk Shares tradable in privacy-preserving, permissioned secondary markets with institutional-grade compliance
5) Automating Claims with Zero-Knowledge Proofs using Poseidon hashing for privacy-preserving, fast and auditable claim resolution
